hooks.command: cd "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)" && { ! git diff --quiet HEAD 2>/dev/null || git ls-files --others --exclude-standard | grep -q . 2>/dev/null; } && git add -A && git commit -m "snapshot: $(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S) pre-edit" 2>/dev/null || true
hooks.statusMessage: 改修前の状態をGitにコミット中...
